sections.title: What’s included
body: One service, done where your vehicle is: we remove the damaged windshield and install the new one at the location we agreed on.
list: A free quote for your vehicle
No extra charge for mobile service
Instructions specific to your installation
A warranty on your replacement, explained with your quote

sections.title: What we need from you
body: A few details are enough to get started. If you don’t have everything, send what you have and we’ll work through the rest together.
list: Your vehicle’s year, make and model
Where the vehicle will be parked
A photo of the damage, by text if you can
Your VIN, if you have it: on your registration or insurance documents, or usually at the lower driver-side windshield
Any cameras or driver-assist features

sections.title: Where it happens
body: Tell us where the vehicle will be. We confirm the location and working conditions with you before the appointment, so there are no surprises on the day.

sections.title: After the installation
body: We explain when you can drive again and what precautions to take when washing and using your vehicle. These instructions depend on your particular installation, so ask us if anything is unclear.

sections.title: Repair or replacement?
body: Our service is replacement. If you’re not sure your windshield needs replacing, text us a photo or describe the damage, and we’ll help you understand the next step before agreeing on any work.

insurance.title: Replacing your windshield with insurance.

sections.title: What your insurer confirms
body: Coverage and deductibles differ from one policy to another, so your insurer is the right place for these answers. A few questions worth asking:
list: Is windshield replacement covered by my policy?
What is my deductible for this kind of damage?
Do you need anything from me before the work is done?

sections.title: What Vitreva provides
body: A quote for your vehicle and the windshield it needs, which you can add to your claim. The quote is free, and you decide whether to go ahead once you know where you stand.

sections.title: How it usually goes
body: Each insurer has its own process, but these are the steps on our side.
list: Send us your vehicle details and a photo of the damage
Get a reply within 24 hours, then your free quote
Check your coverage and deductible with your insurer
Confirm the location and appointment with us

cameras.title: Windshields with cameras and driver-assist sensors.
cameras.intro: Many recent vehicles have a camera or sensors mounted at the windshield. Tell us about them up front, so this step is clear before your replacement is confirmed.

sections.title: Why it matters
body: Driver-assist features can rely on a camera mounted at the windshield. After a replacement, some vehicles need that system calibrated, which is known as ADAS calibration.

sections.title: What Vitreva does
body: Vitreva replaces windshields and does not perform ADAS calibration. If your vehicle needs it, we refer you to an appropriate provider and help clarify that step before confirming the replacement.

sections.title: What to tell us
body: You don’t need to know the technical details. Just share what you can see or what you already know about your vehicle.
list: Your vehicle’s year, make and model
Whether there’s a camera or sensor near the rearview mirror
Any driver-assist features you know of
A photo of the area behind the rearview mirror, if you’re not sure
